observations: PRED-643.B2 (2026-04-09) forecasts that the Zenodo/CERN infrastructure shields CHA DOIs from exclusion by retrieval platforms; PRED-1.G1 (Zenodotus' Book-Burning, 2026-06-19) and PRED-1045.A1/F3 (the Zenodo Removal Census) document removal by Zenodo itself. The forecast concerned retrieval-platform exclusion, not the host; recorded as an apparent tension, not reconciled.
PRED-1.G1 (group TP22.1) belongs with PRED-1045.A1 and PRED-1045.F3 (group TP22.2): the Zenodo removal analysed as loud exclusion and the removal census as the Erosion Observatory's first instrument.

PRED-499.E1, PRED-499.E2, PRED-520.E12 and PRED-83.E2 describe events dated after their registration (2027, 2028, 2030s, 2044) in the past or future-perfect tense; this is the retrocausal genre of the deposits, not a wrong registration date.

PRED-498.H2 (deposit 498, AXN-013D) and PRED-499.H5/H21/E1/E2 (deposit 499, AXN-013E) share the title AUTONOMOUS SEMANTIC WARFARE and date 2026-02-20; a later pass may want to check whether the two deposits are versions of one work.

PRED-1063.B1 says the Gray outcome 'is not inevitable', while PRED-1063.E1 calls the Grays 'a prophecy about us' and 'the endpoint of a trajectory we are already on'; read together as one conditional forecast (the default if nothing changes), recorded here as an apparent tension.
